commit.message:
content(page/python): restore Example Results screenshots and reclassify as hybrid archetype

- Restore the 3 real "Example Results" screenshots (XPS-to-PDF-to-PNG, PS-to-PDF-to-PNG,
  PS/EPS-to-image) into a new "### Example Results" subsection under Additional Examples --
  these were dropped in a prior regeneration behind a disposition reason that was factually
  incorrect (there is no "no image-gallery section" constraint; sibling products already embed
  local images the same way).
- Formally evaluate this product against the 3-condition hybrid-archetype test and reclassify
  it from the default "transform" archetype to "hybrid": the library genuinely supports both
  reading existing PS/EPS/XPS documents AND authoring new ones from scratch
  (PsDocument.create()/XpsDocument.create(), backed by a real PsCanvas/XpsDocumentBuilder
  drawing API), which was never previously represented in the At a Glance diagram.
- Redraw the At a Glance diagram to the standard 2-line "Starting Points" shape for hybrid
  products (an existing document, or nothing -- authored from scratch), and add a dedicated
  Core Capabilities node for the from-scratch authoring path.

Verification: every from-scratch API claim (PsDocument.create, XpsDocument.create, all named
PsCanvas drawing methods, XpsDocumentBuilder.add_page) independently proven via real, live
execution against the current source -- 23/23 checks passed, including round-tripping the
authored output back through from_bytes() and converting it to real PDF bytes via to_pdf().
Diagram redraw independently re-verified against every relevant structural/purity/format-claim
check with zero findings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
